name: PhD in Physics and Materials (Materials Science and Nanomaterials)
department: Faculty of Science — Department of Physics and Materials (PM)

deadline.value: 2027/28 Semester One (September 2027 entry) application deadline is 2027-05-31 (31 May 2027 for most STEM departments; 30 April 2027 for Rehabilitation Sciences; HKPFS single-round deadline is 1 December 2026).
deadline.quote: 2027/28 | Semester One | (Sep 2027 Entry) | Department of Physics and Materials (PM) | 31 May 2027

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology; no GRE Subject Test exists for this discipline.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to contact a potential supervisor before submitting an application, though an application can still be submitted without identifying a supervisor in advance.
supervisor.quote: 17. Do I need to contact a supervisor in advance before applying? | Applicants are advised to contact a potential supervisor before submission of an application. However, you can still submit an application without identifying a potential supervisor.

funding.value: Full-time PhD applicants are automatically considered for the PolyU Research Postgraduate Scholarship (PRPgS: HK$230,640/yr, rising to HK$235,920/yr after confirmation of registration, plus HK$25,000 conference grant), International PhD Fellowship Scheme (IPFS: HK$230,640–235,920/yr + tuition waiver), PolyU Presidential PhD Fellowship (PPPFS: HK$340,800/yr + tuition waiver), and HKPFS (HK$344,400/yr + tuition waiver).
funding.quote: PolyU Research Postgraduate Scholarship (PRPgS) | PRPgS aims to provide financial support to PhD and MPhil students during their normal study period, allowing them to fully focus on their studies. Applicants will concurrently be considered for the PRPgS once they submit an application via RPgAdmission, no separate application is required. The PRPgS package includes: | Annual Stipend: HK$230,640 | HK$235,920 for PhD students who have confirmed registration

entry_route.value: Admits applicants with a Bachelor's degree with First Class Honours or a Master's degree into the 4-year full-time PhD programme, and applicants with an MPhil or research Master's degree (with dissertation) into the 3-year full-time PhD programme.
entry_route.quote: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) | (3-year full-time/6-year part-time) | normally hold a Master of Philosophy (MPhil) or equivalent (a research postgraduate degree with a dissertation as an award requirement) and a Bachelor's degree, conferred by a recognised university | Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) | (4-year full-time/8-year part-time) | A Master’s degree and a Bachelor's degree, conferred by a recognised university; OR | A Bachelor’s degree with First Class Honours (or equivalent qualification), conferred by a recognised university.

notes: Housed in the Department of Physics and Materials (PM, Programme Code 11601), covering Nanomaterials & Micro/Nanoelectronics, Green Energy & Carbon Neutrality (batteries, ferroelectric/dielectric and photovoltaic materials), and Photonics, Plasmonics & Optoelectronics.
